svg.title: Riju volunteers his Crosswalk while Ila asks if he is ready.
svg.desc: Riju stands with one hand on his refurbished terminal, his temporary card swinging forward. He says the Crosswalk can handle the trial; Ila looks up and asks whether he can.
svg.text: Page 10, panel 3 · Tight medium close-up on Riju volunteering

text.tspan: Riju accepts responsibility for using the Crosswalk
